_comment: Human-verified overrides layered on top of the full official LOINC table (see loinc_loader.py / normalization.build_alias_index). The full table's own RELATEDNAMES2 field genuinely lists common abbreviations (e.g. 'Hgb', 'WBC', 'SGPT') against MANY distinct related codes -- real ambiguity, not a bug -- so build_alias_index correctly refuses to guess among them. This file supplies the single correct answer for the handful of extremely common, specimen-independent abbreviations we've manually verified, so those don't unnecessarily fall through to the LLM stage. Deliberately EXCLUDES anything with a real specimen-dependent ambiguity (e.g. bare 'Glucose' or 'Protein', which can mean a different LOINC concept in urine vs serum/blood) -- those must keep going through the context-aware lexical-search+LLM stage, which is what fixed the urine-glucose mismapping bug.
